sentences.en: Which, you mean it like regardless of whatever's happening, no matter how old you are, you're always going to look back at like this moment as the good old days, right?
sentences.zh: 也就是，你的意思是无论发生了什么，不管你多大，你总是会回想起现在的这一刻，把它当成美好的旧时光，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, because we look back at things and we say, oh, this was so wonderful, but we don't appreciate them when they're happening.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我们回首往事时会说，哦，那时候太美妙了，但在当时发生时我们并不懂得珍惜。

sentences.en: And if you look at things as you would look at them from the future, then you can see how precious they are much more easily.
sentences.zh: 如果你用未来的眼光来看待现在的事物，你就会更容易发现它们有多么珍贵。

sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得不是我编的，但是，嗯，这纯粹是经验之谈。

sentences.en: It's like, I look at that photo and I thought at the time I looked so this and so that it's like, wow, looking at that time years later, I looked so wonderful.
sentences.zh: 就像，我看着那张照片，当时我觉得自己这样那样，感觉就是，哇，多年后回看那个时候，我看起来太棒了。

sentences.en: I wish I could have appreciated it then.
sentences.zh: 我要是当时能懂得珍惜就好了。

sentences.en: And I don't know how many decades it took me to finally realize it, you know, but I did want to pass that on to you before it was too late.

sentences.en: And I'm so happy it took.

sentences.en: My name is Jane Dee.

sentences.en: I'm originally from Somerset, Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 我原本来自马萨诸塞州萨默塞特。

sentences.en: My mother had a lot of sayings.
sentences.zh: 我母亲有很多口头禅。

sentences.en: I don't know if they're mantras, but they're certainly mom-isMs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这算不算座右铭，但绝对是妈妈式金句。

sentences.en: Every time my brother or sister or I were about to leave the house, she would remind us that all tragedy starts out in fun.
sentences.zh: 每当我和弟弟妹妹或者我要离开家时，她总会提醒我们，所有的悲剧都始于贪玩。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, but way to bring the room down, Mom.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，妈妈，你可真会把气氛搞砸。

sentences.en: My mom-ism or mom mantra is, hey, you're not the only tin can in the dump.
sentences.zh: 我的妈妈式金句或座右铭是：嘿，垃圾堆里可不止你一个空罐头。

sentences.en: Gargle with salt water.
sentences.zh: 用盐水漱口。

sentences.en: Grab it and growl.
sentences.zh: 抓住它然后低吼。

sentences.en: Life is like a Mardi Gras.
sentences.zh: 生活就像狂欢节。

sentences.en: You're just rattling around like a fart in a skillet.
sentences.zh: 你就像平底锅里的屁一样到处乱撞。

sentences.en: I'm Alex, and I'm from Montpelier, Vermont.
sentences.zh: 我是亚历克斯，来自佛蒙特州蒙彼利埃。

sentences.en: My mom's expression is, boo.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的口头禅是：嘘。

sentences.en: Let me explain.
sentences.zh: 听我解释。

sentences.en: My mom's a first grade teacher.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是一名一年级老师。

sentences.en: And one day when she was co-teaching, this little boy stands up in the middle of her lesson, looks at her, and just goes, boo.
sentences.zh: 有一天，当她在和其他老师一起上课时，一个小男孩在她的课堂中间站了起来，看着她，然后直接说：嘘。

sentences.en: Boo.
sentences.zh: 嘘。

sentences.en: Traditionally, booing is not encouraged at school.
sentences.zh: 传统上，在学校里是不鼓励发出嘘声的。

sentences.en: But when she got home that day, she told me about it.
sentences.zh: 但那天她回家后，把这件事告诉我了。

sentences.en: And we couldn't help but laugh because it's kind of the perfect response to any situation where you have no control, but you are not happy about it.
sentences.zh: 我们忍不住笑了，因为这简直是对任何你无法控制、但又对此很不爽的处境的完美回应。

sentences.en: Howdy.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: I'm Richard Martin from Austin, Texas.
sentences.zh: 我是来自德克萨斯州奥斯汀的理查德·马丁。

sentences.en: Texas is a state brimming with colorful expressions.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州是一个充满生动表达的州。

sentences.en: And one that I heard frequently from my grandmother was, take an onion out of that stew.
sentences.zh: 我经常从我祖母那里听到的一句话是：从那个炖菜里拿出一颗洋葱。

sentences.en: Which meant, I know you're lying to me.
sentences.zh: 意思是，我知道你在对我撒谎。

sentences.en: Straighten up and tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 老实点，说实话。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: My name is Gwen Harvey.
sentences.zh: 我叫格温·哈维。

sentences.en: I live in Portland, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 我住在俄勒冈州波特兰。

sentences.en: My mom's expression was, when in doubt, clean.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的口头禅是：拿不定主意时，就打扫卫生。

sentences.en: If something is bothering you, dear child, put yourself to work.
sentences.zh: 如果有什么烦心事，好孩子，去找点活干。

sentences.en: Clean a closet.
sentences.zh: 收拾一下衣柜。

sentences.en: Clean out a cupboard.
sentences.zh: 清理一下碗橱。

sentences.en: Wash the car.
sentences.zh: 洗洗车。

sentences.en: Wash the dog.
sentences.zh: 给狗洗个澡。

sentences.en: If you haven't figured out an answer or answers, at least you come away with some evidence of things being better.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没想出一个或几个答案，至少你还能看到事情正在变好的证据。

sentences.en: Howdy.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: This is Bobby.
sentences.zh: 我是鲍比。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm in Central Texas.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我在德克萨斯州中部。

sentences.en: I got a great story for you, okay?
sentences.zh: 我有个很棒的故事要讲给你听，好吗？

sentences.en: I was stopped by the folks' house, and I was pulling into the garage.
sentences.zh: 我顺路去了爸妈家，正把车开进车库。

sentences.en: And as I pulled in, I noticed Mom had a half bottle of Windex in one hand and a cleaning rag in the other.
sentences.zh: 当我把车开进去时，我注意到妈妈一只手拿着半瓶威霸玻璃水，另一只手拿着一块清洁抹布。

sentences.en: And as she was stepping back, she was looking back at whatever she had been Windexing.
sentences.zh: 当她往后退的时候，她回过头看着她刚刚擦过的地方。

sentences.en: And as I got out of my car, I said, Ma, what you doing?
sentences.zh: 当我下车时，我说，妈，你在干嘛呢？

sentences.en: And she says, I just finished Windexing the water heater.
sentences.zh: 她说，我刚把热水器擦干净。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh, God, I mean, my eyes rolled back in my head.
sentences.zh: 我说，噢天哪，我的白眼都快翻到后脑勺去了。

sentences.en: So I said, Ma, honey, it's time for you to get a hobby.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，妈，亲爱的，你该找个爱好了。

sentences.en: And she just kept grinning and beaming and staring at that water heater.
sentences.zh: 她只是咧着嘴笑，满面春风地盯着那个热水器。

sentences.en: And she says, I love the smell of Windex in the morning.
sentences.zh: 她说，我喜欢清晨威霸玻璃水的味道。

sentences.en: It smells like victory.
sentences.zh: 闻起来就像胜利。

sentences.en: My name is Jesse Kay, and I live in Miami, Florida.
sentences.zh: 我叫杰西·凯，住在佛罗里达州迈阿密。

sentences.en: My mom always tells me, Jesse, with one behind, you can't sit on the whole world.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈总是对我说，杰西，就凭一个屁股，你可坐不下整个世界。

sentences.en: And this is passed down from my grandmother, who used to tell us, with one togas, you can't sit on the whole world.
sentences.zh: 这话是我奶奶传下来的，她以前常对我们说，只有一件托加长袍，你是没法坐满整个世界的。

sentences.en: And what my mom means by this is essentially, you can't do everything at once.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈这话的意思本质上就是，你不能一口气做所有事情。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Giselle Gauguin, and I live in Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫吉塞尔·高更，我住在加拿大新不伦瑞克省弗雷德里克顿。

sentences.en: My mother, Gail, has a favorite expression, and it is, there's many a slip between the cup and the lip.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈盖尔有一句口头禅，那就是：嘴边到杯边，变故多端。

sentences.en: And it means, you know, don't count your chickens before they're hatched.
sentences.zh: 意思就是，你知道的，不要过早庆功。

sentences.en: Don't get cocky.
sentences.zh: 别太自满。

sentences.en: And it's meant to, you know, bring someone down a peg.
sentences.zh: 它的用意呢，是让人别那么傲慢。

sentences.en: But my mother, being the wonderful person that she is, she always means it in the context of don't worry.
sentences.zh: 但我的母亲，作为那个极其善良的人，她总是将其放在“别担心”的语境下来讲。

sentences.en: Everything is always changing all the time, everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，世事无常，瞬息万变，无处不在。

sentences.en: You know, that situation at work that you can't control, that you're convinced is going to end badly, it probably won't.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，工作中那些你无法控制、你确信会以糟糕结局收场的情况，其实很可能不会。

sentences.en: And if it does, it's probably not going to be as bad as you think, because there's many a slip between the cup and the lip.
sentences.zh: 即使真的发生了，也大概不会像你想的那样糟，因为杯口到嘴边，变故总是很多。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Janine, and I'm from Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫珍妮，我来自费城。

sentences.en: When I was going through my teenage years, my mom would say the same thing to me every time I was heading out the door to meet up with friends.
sentences.zh: 当我经历青春期时，每次我出门和朋友见面，我妈都会对我说同样的话。

sentences.en: Without fail, she would say, no sex, no drugs, only rock and roll.
sentences.zh: 她雷打不动地会说：不要性，不要毒品，只要摇滚乐。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Toby Crockett, and I'm from Paso Robles in California.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫托比·克罗克特，我来自加利福尼亚州的帕索罗布尔斯。

sentences.en: My mom's expression was, don't teach your grandmother how to suck eggs.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的口头禅是：不要教你的祖母吸鸡蛋。

sentences.en: I was always like, okay, well, why would anybody want to suck eggs, one?
sentences.zh: 我总是想，好吧，首先，为什么会有人想去吸鸡蛋？

sentences.en: Why would anybody need to be taught how to suck eggs, two?
sentences.zh: 其次，为什么会有人需要别人教怎么吸鸡蛋？

sentences.en: And what did my grandmother have to do with it?
sentences.zh: 这跟我奶奶有什么关系？

sentences.en: Because she did not seem like the egg-sucking type.
sentences.zh: 因为她看起来可不像是会吸鸡蛋的人。

sentences.en: Of course, later, I learned more about it, you know, and understood that this was supposed to mean,
sentences.zh: 当然，后来我了解更多了，你知道的，也明白了这其实是想说——

sentences.en: hey, stupid whippersnapper, don't tell me how to do what I already know how to do, like, a million times better than you do.
sentences.zh: 嘿，愚蠢的黄口小儿，别教我怎么做那些我早就轻车熟路、比你做得好上百万倍的事情。

sentences.en: And while it might have been somewhat confusing as a child, now that I'm in my 60s, oh, it's so righteous.
sentences.zh: 虽然小时候可能会觉得有些困惑，但现在我六十多岁了，哦，简直太对了。

sentences.en: How many times do I want to say this?
sentences.zh: 我有多少次想这么说呢？

sentences.en: It's sort of like the all-purpose version of mansplaining.
sentences.zh: 这就有点像万能版的“说教男”。

sentences.en: Like, don't mansplain me, and don't teach me how to suck eggs either.
sentences.zh: 就像是，别在我面前班门弄斧，也别教我怎么吸鸡蛋。

sentences.en: My name is Hilary Smith.
sentences.zh: 我叫希拉里·史密斯。

sentences.en: I live in Brooklyn, New York.
sentences.zh: 我住在纽约布鲁克林。

sentences.en: I was in middle school, and I was having some kind of meltdown about a school project that just felt too big and too overwhelming and that I was never going to get it done.
sentences.zh: 当时我读初中，因为一个学校的项目情绪有些崩溃，感觉任务太重、太压抑，我根本不可能完成。

sentences.en: And in the middle of my freakout, my mom said to me,
sentences.zh: 就在我抓狂的时候，我妈妈对我说：

sentences.en: Hilary, how do you eat an elephant?
sentences.zh: 希拉里，你怎么吃一头大象？

sentences.en: And I was kind of like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时有点懵，心想：什么？

sentences.en: What is she asking me?
sentences.zh: 她问我这个干嘛？

sentences.en: And I thought about it, and I was, like, in a giant gulp.
sentences.zh: 我想了想，然后回答说，一口吞下去呗。

sentences.en: And she was like, no, one bite at a time.
sentences.zh: 她说，不对，一次吃一口。

sentences.en: Hi, friends.
sentences.zh: 嗨，朋友们。

sentences.en: This is Jonathan Cabrera.
sentences.zh: 我是乔纳森·卡布雷拉。

sentences.en: I'm originally from Greensboro, North Carolina, and have lived in New York for 11 years.
sentences.zh: 我原本来自北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒，在纽约已经住了11年。

sentences.en: My mom's mantra, motto, expression was,
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的座右铭、口头禅、习惯用语是：

sentences.en: Sing out, Louise!
sentences.zh: 大声唱出来，露易丝！

sentences.en: Which, for those of you who don't know, is a famous line from the musical Gypsy.
sentences.zh: 如果不了解的话，这其实是音乐剧《吉普赛人》里的一句名言。

sentences.en: And my mother, Pauline Cabrera, was Mama Rose incarnate.
sentences.zh: 而我的母亲保利娜·卡布雷拉，就是罗斯妈妈的化身。

sentences.en: And she just was a force of life and a tornado in every room she walked into.
sentences.zh: 她浑身充满生命力，走进任何一个房间都像是一场龙卷风。

sentences.en: And Sing out, Louise, meant to my mother to always let your presence be known in every room that you walk into, to make a choice, be specific in that choice,
sentences.zh: 对母亲而言，“大声唱出来，露易丝”意味着无论走进哪个房间都要让大家注意到你的存在，要做出抉择，在抉择中要具体明确，

sentences.en: damn the torpedoes on whatever choice you did make, and to carpe diem.
sentences.zh: 无论做出什么决定都无所畏惧，并且要及时行乐。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Phoebe.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是菲比。

sentences.en: I'm from Fairfield, Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 我来自康涅狄格州费尔德。

sentences.en: I come from a long line of Syrian women who have intense, unfriendly, frowning faces.
sentences.zh: 我们家族有一长串叙利亚女性，都有着严肃、不友善、紧锁双眉的面相。

sentences.en: And when people meet us, they tend to think we don't like them.
sentences.zh: 人们遇到我们时，往往会觉得我们不喜欢他们。

sentences.en: And so, usually, this is something that I try to overcome.
sentences.zh: 所以通常情况下，我都在努力克服这一点。

sentences.en: But my mom always, always, always reminds us that we have a Syrian look and we can use it on anyone who has wronged us or whenever we need to stand up for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但我妈妈总是、总是、总是在提醒我们，我们长着一张叙利亚脸，我们可以用它来对付任何对不起我们的人，或者任何我们需要挺身而出的时候。

sentences.en: If someone was being mean to us at school, she would say, give them the Syrian look.
sentences.zh: 如果我们在学校里受到别人的刻薄对待，她就会说：给他们摆出叙利亚人的脸色。

sentences.en: And she meant, cut your eyes to them, give them the stank eye, and let them know you can't be messed with.
sentences.zh: 她的意思是，斜眼鄙视他们，给他们一个嫌弃的眼神，让他们知道你可不是好惹的。

sentences.en: My name is Sean Statham.
sentences.zh: 我叫肖恩·斯坦瑟姆。

sentences.en: I live in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 我住在西雅图。

sentences.en: My mom's expression was, roll with the cookie.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的口头禅是：顺着饼干走。

sentences.en: And she would say this typically when the plans had suddenly gone awry.
sentences.zh: 她通常在计划突然泡汤时说这句话。

sentences.en: And she needed her five children to get in line in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 当时她需要她那五个孩子赶快排好队。

sentences.en: And when I was older, I realized that this was her unintentional mashup of roll with the punches.
sentences.zh: 等我长大后，我才意识到这是她无意中把“兵来将挡，水来土掩”（roll with the punches）

sentences.en: And that's the way the cookie crumbles.
sentences.zh: 和“世事难料”（that's the way the cookie crumbles）混杂在了一起。

sentences.en: And when I was younger, I thought every family used it.
sentences.zh: 当我更小的时候，我还以为每个家庭都这么用呢。

sentences.en: And later did I realize that it was unique to us.
sentences.zh: 后来我才发现这是我们家独有的。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Carrie O'Grady, and I'm from Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是嘉莉·奥格雷迪，我来自曼哈顿。

sentences.en: So my mom's mantra was, if you feel bad, look better.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的座右铭是：如果你感觉糟糕，那就让自己看起来好一点。

sentences.en: My mom and I are complete opposites.
sentences.zh: 我和我妈完全是两个极端。

sentences.en: And she is always perfectly put together, and I am not.
sentences.zh: 她总是把自己收拾得一丝不苟，而我却没有。

sentences.en: When I was a teenager, anytime I felt bad, whether it be over a boy or my skin or just life in general,
sentences.zh: 当我还是个青少年时，任何时候只要我心情不好，不管是为情所困、皮肤问题还是生活中的琐事，

sentences.en: my go-to was wanting to hide in my room, in bed, sweatpants, PJs, no makeup, and probably Ben and Jerry's.
sentences.zh: 我的第一反应就是想躲在房间的床上，穿着运动裤、睡衣，不化妆，可能还要吃上一桶本杰瑞冰激凌。

sentences.en: But my mom would come in, and she would say, get up, put on something cute, do your makeup, and you'll feel better.
sentences.zh: 但我妈会走进来，对我说：起来，穿件漂亮的衣服，化个妆，你就会感觉好多了。

sentences.en: And at the time, I found this insanely annoying.
sentences.zh: 当时我觉得这简直烦透了。

sentences.en: And to be honest, I still do.
sentences.zh: 说实话，现在我还是这么觉得。

sentences.en: But now, I'm almost 43, and I'm a professor, and I commute nearly four and a half hours to and from my university, multiple days per week.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我快43岁了，是一名教授，每周有几天都要往返于大学，单程通勤将近四个半小时。

sentences.en: I live out of bags, and I'm perpetually exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我过着拎包出差的生活，而且永远筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: But when I pack now, I find myself throwing in something a little extra, whether it be a zebra print or a bedazzled headband or some high heels.
sentences.zh: 但现在收拾行李时，我发现自己总会顺手塞进一些稍微特别的东西，比如一件斑马纹衣服、一个镶钻发带或几双高跟鞋。

sentences.en: I've even perfected applying eyeliner on the Peter Pan bus.
sentences.zh: 我甚至已经在彼得潘长途汽车上练就了涂眼线的高超技术。

sentences.en: So when I get to work, and a student says to me, I love your outfit today, or you look great today,
sentences.zh: 所以当我到达学校，有学生对我说“老师我喜欢你今天的穿着”或者“你今天看起来真棒”时，

sentences.en: I immediately feel more awake than I would otherwise, more ready to conquer my day.
sentences.zh: 我顿时觉得自己比平时更有精神了，也更有信心去征服这一天。

sentences.en: And while I'm still not ready to say my mom was right, I'll admit that she was on to something.
sentences.zh: 虽然我还是不愿承认我妈是对的，但我得承认她确实说得有道理。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Nisan.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫尼桑。

sentences.en: I'm from New York.
sentences.zh: 我来自纽约。

sentences.en: Grew up in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 在新泽西长大。

sentences.en: And my mom's line, anytime we went shopping, I'd pick something up, a candle, a jewelry box, ripped jeans, literally anything.
sentences.zh: 我妈的一句口头禅是，每次我们去购物，我随便拿起一样东西——蜡烛、首饰盒、破洞牛仔裤，简直任何东西，

sentences.en: And she'd turn it over in her hands, pause, and without fail, say, we can make that, and then return the item to the shelf.
sentences.zh: 她都会拿在手里翻来覆去地看，停顿一下，然后雷打不动地说：我们能自己做，接着就把东西放回货架上。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Erin, and I'm from Irvine, California.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我叫艾琳，我来自加利福尼亚州尔湾。

sentences.en: And one of my mom's favorite expressions is, the grass will soon turn to milk.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈最喜欢的口头禅之一是：草很快就会变成牛奶。

sentences.en: If you think about a cow in a field of grass, the cow eats the grass, and then the grass goes through this labyrinthine digestive process, and then becomes milk, eventually, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你想象一头牛在草地上，牛吃草，然后草经过复杂的消化过程，最后变成了牛奶，对吧？

sentences.en: So it's this idea that it might take a while, but your hard work will pay off and result in this beautiful, delicious, good thing, the milk.
sentences.zh: 所以这个意思就是，可能需要一段时间，但你的努力终会有所回报，并结出美丽、美味的果实，也就是“牛奶”。

sentences.en: My mom, as a mother of 12, had many mantras.
sentences.zh: 我的母亲作为12个孩子的妈妈，有很多口头禅。

sentences.en: One of my favorite ones was, oh, honey, she suffers from terminal uniqueness.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一句是：哦，亲爱的，她患有“绝症般的独特性”。

sentences.en: A hundred years from now, who will know the difference?
sentences.zh: 一百年后，谁会知道有什么区别呢？

sentences.en: If in doubt, do without.
sentences.zh: 拿不准主意时，就别买。

sentences.en: Oh, God, who cares?
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: We're on an adventure.
sentences.zh: 我们在进行一场冒险。

sentences.en: Don't make fun of something that someone that you love, loves.
sentences.zh: 不要去嘲笑你爱的人所热爱的事物。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Anna Curtis, and I'm from Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫安娜·柯蒂斯，我来自加拿大阿尔伯塔省埃德蒙顿。

sentences.en: My mother's saying was, there isn't a shroud with pockets big enough, which is a slightly more morbid way of saying, you can't take it with you when you go.
sentences.zh: 我母亲常说的话是：寿衣上没有带口袋的兜，换句话说，也就是生不带来，死不带去。

sentences.en: That, my mother lived that.
sentences.zh: 这一点，我的母亲真正做到了极致。

sentences.en: She lived that by having adventures, by going and exploring, by, and not just adventures in terms of travel, but adventures in terms of things that she did with her life,
sentences.zh: 她通过去冒险、去探索来践行这一点，而且不仅仅是旅行意义上的冒险，还包括她一生中所做之事的冒险，

sentences.en: the way she raised six children.
sentences.zh: 以及她抚养六个孩子的方式。

sentences.en: It all fell into this idea that life is for the now, and the living, and you have to grab it.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归结于一个理念：生命属于当下，属于活着，你必须去抓住它。

sentences.en: And there was always an adventure in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们的生活中总是不缺冒险。

sentences.en: Even things like, we took an epic road trip from Winnipeg, Manitoba up to Circle Alaska on an unpaved Alaskan highway in a Volkswagen Beetle with nothing but a tent on the top.
sentences.zh: 甚至比如，我们曾开着一辆大众甲壳虫，车顶只绑了一个帐篷，进行了一场史诗级的自驾游，从马尼托巴省温尼伯一路向北开到阿拉斯加州瑟克尔，走的是阿拉斯加未铺装的高速公路。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's reflective of the fact that they didn't sit back and go, we haven't got enough money to go.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这反映出一个事实：他们从不坐视不管，然后说“我们没有足够的钱去”。

sentences.en: They just went, how do we make this happen?
sentences.zh: 他们只会说：我们该怎么实现这个？

sentences.en: How do we have this adventure in our lives?
sentences.zh: 我们怎样才能在生活中经历这场冒险？

sentences.en: And so, when my mother passed away many years ago, there wasn't any money left.
sentences.zh: 所以，多年前我母亲去世时，并没有留下什么钱。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: There wasn't a shroud with pockets big enough.
sentences.zh: 寿衣上没有带口袋的兜。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Danielle, and I live in Alamo, California.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我叫丹妮尔，我住在加利福尼亚州阿拉莫。

sentences.en: My mom is this tiny, fiery, extremely loving little Sicilian woman.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是一个身材娇小、风风火火、极其慈爱的西西里小妇人。

sentences.en: To know her is to be loved by her and protected by her.
sentences.zh: 了解她的人都会被她所爱、所庇护。

sentences.en: But, oof, if you do something she thinks is not right, you will know it.
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，如果你做了她认为不对的事，你绝对会吃不了兜着走。

sentences.en: This is important context for her mantra that has always stuck with me, which is, just because someone throws you a football doesn't mean you have to catch it.
sentences.zh: 了解这个背景很重要，因为她的这句话一直深深刻在我脑海里：别人给你扔橄榄球，不代表你非得接住。

sentences.en: And what she means by that is that all through our lives, people will give you feedback or criticism or they'll make you feel bad about something.
sentences.zh: 她的意思是，在我们的一生中，人们会给你反馈、批评，或者让你对某些事感到难过。

sentences.en: And you can just say, thank you for the feedback, and just not take it in because it wasn't yours.
sentences.zh: 而你大可以只说一句“谢谢你的反馈”，然后选择不往心里去，因为那根本不是你的问题。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Kelsey, and I grew up in Bloomington, Indiana.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫凯尔西，我在印第安纳州布卢明顿长大。

sentences.en: My mom always used to say, some things just are.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈以前总是说：有些事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Originally, the story behind it was I was a kid that just needed to know why, why, why, why.
sentences.zh: 最初这个故事的背景是，我是一个总要追问为什么、为什么、为什么的小孩。

sentences.en: And I imagine for a mom juggling all of the things that she was at that time and having a kid who my dad said came out of the chute litigating, that's a little crass.
sentences.zh: 我能想象，对一个当时要兼顾各种事情的妈妈来说，还要应付一个我爸说“一出娘胎就在那儿搞辩论”的孩子，这话听起来有点粗鲁。

sentences.en: But, you know, when you're younger, you always believe there's an answer for absolutely everything.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，当你年轻的时候，你总是相信绝对每件事都有答案。

sentences.en: And so, as I got older, I sort of just tapped into it kind of like a touchstone, and I would remind myself some things just are.
sentences.zh: 所以，随着我长大，我开始把这句话当作心灵支柱一样运用，每当这时我就会提醒自己——有些事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Jeff, and I live in Little Rock, Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是杰夫，我住在阿肯色州小石城。

sentences.en: My mother's mantra was, if you're lost, any road will take you there.
sentences.zh: 我母亲的座右铭是：如果你迷路了，任何一条路都能带你到达。

sentences.en: My name is Diane Falcone.
sentences.zh: 我叫黛安·法尔科内。

sentences.en: I live in Yonkers, New York.
sentences.zh: 我住在纽约扬克斯。

sentences.en: Something I heard from my mom a lot when I was growing up was, God punishes you.
sentences.zh: 我小时候经常从我妈那里听到的一句话是：上帝惩罚你。

sentences.en: And you might wonder, why would your mom say that to you?
sentences.zh: 你可能会纳闷，你妈怎么会这么对你说话？

sentences.en: For some context, my mom was a devout Catholic.
sentences.zh: 作为背景，我妈妈是个虔诚的天主教徒。

sentences.en: She tried to become a nun twice in her life.
sentences.zh: 她一生中曾两次尝试成为修女。

sentences.en: My parents were very active in their parish.
sentences.zh: 我父母在他们的教区非常活跃。

sentences.en: We did church on Sundays, and I even wore that little doily on my head back when women had to wear that to church on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我们周日去教堂做礼拜，当年女性去教堂必须在头上戴那种小蕾丝方巾时，我也戴过。

sentences.en: So God in my household was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 所以上帝在我们家是一件大事。

sentences.en: So if someone were to have a minor injury, like they would bump their head or stub their toe, or pinch a finger,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果有人受了点小伤，比如撞了头、脚趾磕了，或者夹了手指，

sentences.en: instead of getting a response from my mom, like, oh, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 我得到的不是妈妈“噢，你还好吗？”这样的关心，

sentences.en: I would get, God punishes you.
sentences.zh: 而是听到一句：上帝惩罚你。

sentences.en: Which for me, it was horrifying, first of all, because I'm a tiny child.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，首先这简直太可怕了，因为我还只是个小孩子。

sentences.en: I don't know what I did to piss off God.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己做了什么惹上帝生气的事。

sentences.en: But I feel like it was my mom's way of saying, well, you must have done something to deserve that.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这是我妈妈的一种表达方式，意思是：你肯定做了什么才落得这个下场。

sentences.en: I didn't see it, so God punishes you.
sentences.zh: 我没看到，所以是上帝在惩罚你。

sentences.en: I'm Kay from Port Angeles, Washington.
sentences.zh: 我是来自华盛顿州安吉利斯港的凯。

sentences.en: And my mom's mantra was, this too shall pass.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的口头禅是：这一切都会过去的。

sentences.en: Oh boy, did I hate to hear that.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我当时最讨厌听到这句话了。

sentences.en: She'd say it when I was a teenager, and I don't know, if I was complaining or something.
sentences.zh: 每当我还是个青少年在抱怨什么的时候，她就会说这句话。

sentences.en: And you know, honestly, it felt a little dismissive.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这感觉有点敷衍。

sentences.en: But now, I'm 61 years old.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我61岁了。

sentences.en: I kind of get it.
sentences.zh: 我有点懂了。

sentences.en: And I would so love to hear her say that to me again.
sentences.zh: 我多么希望她能再对我说一次这句话。

sentences.en: I miss you, Mom.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我想你了。

sentences.en: Our mother would say, rain makes you beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我们的母亲会说：雨会让你变美。

sentences.en: Misery is optional.
sentences.zh: 痛苦是你可以选择的。

sentences.en: It's never so bad that it couldn't be worse.
sentences.zh: 情况再坏，也不至于无可救药。

sentences.en: She said that I should love myself firSt.
sentences.zh: 她说过我应该首先爱自己。

sentences.en: There is no pillow as soft as a clear conscience.
sentences.zh: 没有比问心无愧更好的枕头了。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Amy Marcus, and I'm from Kailua, Hawaii, living in the San Francisco Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是艾米·马库斯，我来自夏威夷凯鲁瓦，现在住在旧金山湾区。

sentences.en: My phrase that I remember my mom saying a lot, the one that sticks with me, is don't make big decisions late at night.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈经常说、也深深印在我脑海里的一句话是：别在深夜做重大决定。

sentences.en: And she used to say this to me on the phone when I would call her from college because she was still living in Hawaii and I was upstate New York.
sentences.zh: 以前我在大学里打电话给她时，她经常在电话里这么对我说，因为那时她还住在夏威夷，而我在纽约州北部。

sentences.en: So I could call her late at night and it would still be, you know, dinner time for her.
sentences.zh: 所以哪怕我很晚打电话给她，你知道的，对她来说也才刚到吃晚饭的时间。

sentences.en: And I could call her with my anxieties, my worries, my stresses, whatever, just to chat.
sentences.zh: 我可以带着我的焦虑、担忧、压力或任何情绪打电话给她，只是为了聊聊天。

sentences.en: And I remember her saying, just get some sleep, get some rest, don't make big decisions late at night.
sentences.zh: 我记得她总是说，睡个觉，休息一下，千万别在深夜做重大决定。

sentences.en: And now as a parent to a two-year-old myself,
sentences.zh: 而现在，当我自己也成了一个两岁孩子的父母时，

sentences.en: these last few years of pregnancy and new parenthood,
sentences.zh: 经历怀孕和初为人父母的这几年，

sentences.en: I really wish I could call her.
sentences.zh: 我是多么希望能给她打个电话啊。

sentences.en: And I can't because she passed away at the end of 2020 unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 但我不能了，因为她在2020年底意外离世了。

sentences.en: So, you know, parenting has you up at all hours, getting so little sleep.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，当父母会让你时刻醒着，睡眠少得可怜。

sentences.en: And you find yourself maybe Googling sleep training advice for your baby in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 你会发现自己可能在半夜用谷歌搜索关于婴儿睡眠训练的建议。

sentences.en: And then I would hear my mom's voice and she would say, no, don't, don't do this right now.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会听到我妈妈的声音，她会说，不，别这样，现在别做这个。

sentences.en: Go to sleep, get some rest, make this decision when you're feeling a little more rested and can think a little more clearly.
sentences.zh: 去睡觉，休息一下，等你感觉精力稍微恢复一点、能稍微清晰思考的时候再做这个决定。

sentences.en: Hey, this is Sarah from Madison, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是来自威斯康星州麦迪逊的莎拉。

sentences.en: And one of my mom's favorite expressions was, if wishes were horses, then beggars would ride.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈最喜欢的口头禅之一是：如果愿望能成真，乞丐也能骑骏马。

sentences.en: As a kid, I remember her using it in seemingly unrelated situations.
sentences.zh: 小时候，我记得她在各种看似毫不相干的场合用过这句话。

sentences.en: You know, like at a family potluck, someone would say, oh, I wish we had remembered the mayonnaise.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比如在家庭聚餐时，有人会说，哦，我要是记着带蛋黄酱就好了。

sentences.en: And my mom would say, well, if wishes were horses, then beggars would ride.
sentences.zh: 然后我妈妈就会说，嗯，如果愿望能成真，乞丐也能骑骏马。

sentences.en: Totally confusing.
sentences.zh: 完全让人一头雾水。

sentences.en: To things like,
sentences.zh: 到诸如这样的事：

sentences.en: I wish I had gotten into that college.
sentences.zh: 我要是能考上那所大学就好了。

sentences.en: If wishes were horses, then beggars would ride.
sentences.zh: 如果愿望能成真，乞丐也能骑骏马。

sentences.en: And I kind of just always blew it off because I'm like, I have no idea what you mean by that.
sentences.zh: 我当时基本上总是直接忽略，因为我想，我根本不知道你这话是什么意思。

sentences.en: But a few years ago,
sentences.zh: 但就在几年前，

sentences.en: my mom received a terminal cancer diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈被诊断出患有晚期癌症。

sentences.en: And I think I finally knew what she meant.
sentences.zh: 我想我终于明白她是什么意思了。

sentences.en: Because life throws stuff at us.
sentences.zh: 因为生活总是会向我们抛出各种难题。

sentences.en: And you didn't want it.
sentences.zh: 而你并不想要这些。

sentences.en: And you can wish it wasn't happening.
sentences.zh: 你可以希望这一切没有发生。

sentences.en: And I did.
sentences.zh: 而我也确实这么想过。

sentences.en: But that doesn't get you very far.
sentences.zh: 但这并不能帮到你什么。

sentences.en: I miss my mom every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都想念我的妈妈。

sentences.en: But I'm so grateful to have had her and all of her seemingly crazy sayings that have done so much to help me navigate life without her.
sentences.zh: 但能拥有她以及她那些看似疯狂、却在我没有她的日子里极大地帮助我面对生活的名言，我感到无比感恩。

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: My name is Rosemary Rowe.
sentences.zh: 我叫罗斯玛丽·罗。

sentences.en: I live in Sanishton, British Columbia on Vancouver Island in Canada.
sentences.zh: 我住在加拿大温哥华岛不列颠哥伦比亚省的萨尼斯顿。

sentences.en: And an expression that I associate with my awesome mom is, you're a human being.
sentences.zh: 我联想到我那位了不起的妈妈的一句话是：你是一个有人性的人。

sentences.en: Not a human doing.
sentences.zh: 而不是一个只会做事的人。

sentences.en: As in, just being is enough.
sentences.zh: 意思是，单纯地存在就已经足够了。

sentences.en: Now, I have to say, this was always a bit rich coming from my mom, who's a very energetic, accomplished, go, go, go kind of person.
sentences.zh: 不过我得说，这话从我妈嘴里说出来总是有点讽刺，她是一个非常精力充沛、富有成就、雷厉风行的人。

sentences.en: When she was about 40, my mom went through a very, like, intense personal psychological journey of breakthrough and recovery.
sentences.zh: 在我大约40岁时，我妈妈经历了一段非常深刻的个人心理突破与康复之旅。

sentences.en: And she ended up switching careers.
sentences.zh: 她最终转行了。

sentences.en: She got her PhD.
sentences.zh: 她获得了博士学位。

sentences.en: She became a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 她成了一名心理学家。

sentences.en: But it was around this time, those early days, when she started saying to my brother and I,
sentences.zh: 但正是在那个时候，在最初的那段日子里，她开始对我和我弟弟说，

sentences.en: you're a human being, not a human doing.
sentences.zh: 你是一个有人性的人，而不是一个只会做事的人。

sentences.en: And as the years went by, that expression really stuck around.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，这句话一直留存了下来。

sentences.en: Anyway, I feel like this is a great full circle opportunity for me because my mom is in her 70s now and she's recently had a serious heart surgery.
sentences.zh: 总之，我觉得对我来说这是一个绝佳的圆满时刻，因为我妈妈现在七十多岁了，最近刚做了一场大心脏手术。

sentences.en: And she's been a bit frustrated by the pace of her recovery because she's still a very energetic, accomplished, go, go, go kind of person.
sentences.zh: 她对自己的康复速度有点沮丧，因为她依然是一个非常精力充沛、富有成就、雷厉风行的人。

sentences.en: So I just want to take this opportunity to remind her that mom, mom,
sentences.zh: 所以我只想借此机会提醒她，妈妈，妈妈，

sentences.en: you're a human being,
sentences.zh: 你是一个有人性的人，

sentences.en: not a human doing.
sentences.zh: 而不是一个只会做事的人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Okay, mom.
sentences.zh: 好了，妈妈。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: So now that we've listened to a whole lot of wisdom from other moms, mom, do you have any advice for future moms?
sentences.zh: 既然我们听了那么多其他妈妈的智慧之言，妈妈，你对未来的妈妈们有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: Oh, Jesus.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: There's a mantra that you've said to me about being a parent.
sentences.zh: 你曾经对我说过一句关于为人父母的座右铭。

sentences.en: I wonder if you
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否

sentences.en: remember what it is.
sentences.zh: 还记得是什么。

sentences.en: Remember to tell you?
sentences.zh: 记得我跟你说过吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: When you have kids, you do the best job that you can and then you pray that they forgive you.
sentences.zh: 当你有了孩子，你尽自己所能做到最好，然后祈祷他们能原谅你。

sentences.en: Oh, that's, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，就是这样，对。

sentences.en: I'm curious where it came from.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道这句话是哪来的。

sentences.en: Oh, that's my own.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是我的原创。

sentences.en: So, okay.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧。

sentences.en: So my advice for mothers is that we all do the best we can with what we have.
sentences.zh: 所以我给母亲们的建议是，我们所有人都用我们拥有的一切做到了最好。

sentences.en: It's the hardest job in the world
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最困难的工作，

sentences.en: and we're all second-guessing ourselves and we make so many, so many choices and you just do the best you can and you just hope your kids forgive you
sentences.zh: 我们都在不断自我怀疑，我们做出了无数的选择，你只需要尽力做到最好，然后祈祷你的孩子们能够原谅你，

sentences.en: and you do everything with love and even when you're short with them and you're upset, you're still doing the best you can with what you have and you just pray
sentences.zh: 你带着爱去做每一件事，甚至当你对他们失去耐心、感到心烦意乱时，你依然在用你所拥有的做到最好，你只需祈祷，

sentences.en: and you just love them.
sentences.zh: 然后去爱他们。

sentences.en: That's beautiful, Mom.
sentences.zh: 这太美妙了，妈妈。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: Happy Mother's Day, Mom.
sentences.zh: 母亲节快乐，妈妈。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Happy Mother's Day, honey.
sentences.zh: 母亲节快乐，亲爱的。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: Thank you, too.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I love you, too, honey.
sentences.zh: 我也爱你，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Okay, now I have to go recover.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在我得去休息恢复了。

sentences.en: Thanks, dear.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Thank you to all the listeners who sent us voice memos.
sentences.zh: 感谢所有给我们发来语音备忘录的听众。

sentences.en: We got more than we could possibly include, but you all have very quotable moms and we enjoyed listening to all of them.
sentences.zh: 我们收到的语音远远超出了我们能播出的数量，但你们的妈妈们都金句频出，我们听得非常开心。

sentences.zh: 马里安·洛萨诺、丹·鲍威尔和莉亚·肖·达梅伦。

sentences.zh: 由罗文·内米斯托担任音频工程。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢凯瑟琳·皮尔逊和梅洛尼斯·麦卡菲。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《纽约时报晨报》。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是蕾切尔·艾布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎进了一群自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，将讲述人们试图维持自身影响力却最终失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
